verdict.rationale: Neon documents and runtime-probes confirm a live official hosted MCP server (mcp.neon.tech/mcp) with OAuth-gated auth, a 113-tool surface, read-only/category/project scoping verifiable keylessly, and CLI installers (`neon mcp`) that wire the official server into major coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.). Independent runtime probes corroborate the endpoint is live and speaks the documented MCP OAuth flow. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-probe) hands-on report of an agent successfully using the server end-to-end.
